about: What /llms.txt says to agents and other programs, written at each build by site/llms.js. {name}, {url}, {source} are filled from config; the record types and the docs are added from the lexicons and docs/.
intro: {name} ({url}) is a tool for a job hunt, in the browser: it reads an organization's open jobs straight from its own job board (Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, Personio, Recruitee, Rippling, SmartRecruiters, Workable) and its Bluesky account, keeps the organizations, searches and jobs someone saves in their own browser, and lets an organization describe itself and post its jobs on atproto (the Bluesky protocol), from its own account. It keeps no list of organizations or jobs, and nothing of anyone's. Open source (GPL-3.0), no ads, no tracking, no accounts of its own.
lead: There is no index to read: an organization's jobs are on its own job board, and what organizations publish is in their own atproto accounts (the records below). Jobs link to the organization's own posting: apply there. Jobs posted on atproto have their own page here.

etiquette: joblist's requests come from each person's browser, a few job boards at a time; it never crawls.
Link to an organization's page here, or to its job's own posting; never copy applications through joblist, it has none.
An organization that wants a fix: describe it on joblist with its own account (its handle is its domain), or open an issue at {source}/issues.
